summary: Frontend-only regression + new feature testing for iter30 (Options B/C/D/E + video fix). Video URLs correctly updated to media.w3.org (backend fix applied and URLs return HTTP 200 with valid video/mp4). Variance modal fully functional with all required sub-components. Cutoff banner correctly absent when feature disabled. All regression flows pass with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: The DB accumulates many test payroll runs (found 202 variance buttons on /payroll runs history). Consider adding pagination or a cleanup task for old draft runs in dev/test tenants — but this is not a bug, only housekeeping.
test_credentials: admin@gov.sl / GovAdmin@2026 (gov tenant admin, no 2FA) — worked as expected
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded payroll runs (202 draft runs available)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video src URLs are correctly set to media.w3.org/... in the DOM (verified src attribute and currentSrc). URLs return HTTP 200 with content-type video/mp4 (4.3MB for bunny/movie.mp4) via curl. Playback could NOT be verified in headless Chromium because headless Chromium ships without proprietary H.264 codec (v.canPlayType('video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E"') returns ''); real user browsers (Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge) all include H.264 and WILL play these files. If verifying playback is required in automation, either (a) use a real Chrome binary with codecs, or (b) switch to a WebM/VP9 sample. The original defect (403 from retired Google gtv-videos-bucket) is fixed.
